query: SELECT final_state, invocation_generation, producer_id,          eligible_after > clock_timestamp() + interval '89 days' AS "windowed!",          (SELECT string_agg(evidence_id, ',' ORDER BY evidence_kind, evidence_id)            FROM central.provider_completion_references            WHERE completion_receipt_id = r.id) AS "refs!"          FROM central.execution_completion_receipts r          WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND step_attempt_id = $2
